documents.content: Battery: 12 hours continuous playback, 50 hours total with charging case. Fast charging: 10 minutes charge gives 2 hours playback. USB-C charging port. Full charge time: 1.5 hours.
Bluetooth 5.3 with 30m range. Supports AAC, SBC, and LDAC codecs. Multipoint connection: connect to 2 devices simultaneously. Low latency gaming mode (60ms).
Free standard shipping to Southeast Asia (Thailand, Indonesia, Vietnam, Philippines, Malaysia, Singapore). Delivery time: 5-10 business days. Express shipping available: 2-4 business days for $9.99.
30-day no-questions-asked return policy. Free return shipping label provided. Refund processed within 5 business days of receiving return. 1-year warranty against manufacturing defects.
IPX6 water resistance rating. Protected against heavy splashing and sweat. NOT designed for swimming or submersion. Ideal for workouts and rain.
SecureFit ergonomic design tested on 500+ ear shapes. Includes 4 sizes of silicone ear tips (XS, S, M, L) and 3 sizes of wing tips. Weight: 5.4g per earbud.
Standard price: $79.99. Bundle deals available: 2 pairs for $139.99. Student discount: 15% off with valid .edu email. Corporate/bulk orders: contact sales@techbrand.com for quotes.
